name: conversation-visuals
description: Enrich supported Codex and ChatGPT conversations with relevant, sourced or generated visuals while preserving attribution, accessibility, privacy, and user control.

interface.shortDescription: Add relevant sourced and generated visuals
interface.longDescription: Conversation Visuals enriches supported Codex and ChatGPT conversations with carefully selected sourced images, generated illustrations, diagrams, charts, slides, and short media. It stays quiet when a visual would not help, preserves source attribution and accessibility, and degrades honestly on voice or app surfaces that do not expose plugin tools.
defaultPrompt: Enrich this conversation with visuals when they materially help.
Find a sourced visual that helps explain this topic.
Turn this explanation into a concise visual story.
